title: Step 2c - Interpreting Dendrograms: Optimal Clusters in Hierarchical Clustering

cues.en: Instructor: All right, so let's start from the top.
cues.zh: 講師：好，從頂端開始。

cues.en: We have to start from the top.
cues.zh: 必須從頂端開始。

cues.en: And so from the top it goes this way.
cues.zh: 從頂端看，流程是這樣。

cues.en: We start from here, that's the first horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 從這裡開始，這是第一條水平線。

cues.en: And when I move down, move down like that.
cues.zh: 接著往下移，像這樣往下。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: That's when I meet the next horizontal bar. This one.
cues.zh: 這時碰到下一條水平線，就是這條。

cues.en: So actually we made a very small vertical distance here which means that indeed the optimal number of clusters is definitely not two, right?
cues.zh: 這裡的垂直距離很小，表示最佳群組數量肯定不是兩群，對吧？

cues.en: Because here we have two vertical bars.
cues.zh: 因為這裡有兩條垂直線。

cues.en: Then the next step is to start from this second horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 下一步從第二條水平線開始。

cues.en: And so let's do this with our mouse, right?
cues.zh: 用滑鼠來做，對吧？

cues.en: We start from here, the second horizontal bar, and we're gonna go down until we meet the next horizontal bar, which is right here.
cues.zh: 從這裡，第二條水平線開始，往下直到碰到下一條水平線，就在這裡。

cues.en: This one, right?
cues.zh: 這一條，對吧？

cues.en: That's the second horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 這是這一步的第二條水平線。

cues.en: This was the first.
cues.zh: 這是第一條。

cues.en: And from this first to the second, well, we made that vertical distance, okay?
cues.zh: 從第一條到第二條，走了這樣的垂直距離，好嗎？

cues.en: So that's pretty big, which means that maybe, if it is the largest vertical move we can make, well, in that case, the optimal number of clusters would be one, two, three.
cues.zh: 這相當大，表示如果這是能移動的最大垂直距離，最佳群組數量就會是一、二、三。

cues.en: The number of vertical bars we have within this vertical move.
cues.zh: 也就是這個垂直移動區間中的垂直線數量。

cues.en: This one, this one, and this one.
cues.zh: 這條、這條和這條。

cues.en: So that would go four, three clusters.
cues.zh: 所以會選三個群組。

cues.en: All right, so maybe that's the optimal number of clusters but then let's continue.
cues.zh: 這可能是最佳群組數量，但繼續看。

cues.en: Let's continue from here, right?
cues.zh: 從這裡繼續，對吧？

cues.en: So we're gonna continue from here.
cues.zh: 從這裡繼續。

cues.en: That last horizontal bar we met and now I'm going to expand over here.
cues.zh: 也就是剛才碰到的最後一條水平線；現在把範圍延伸到這裡。

cues.en: And same, we're gonna go down until we meet the next horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 一樣往下移，直到碰到下一條水平線。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 到了。

cues.en: That's the next horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 這就是下一條水平線。

cues.en: And here we made a small vertical distance.
cues.zh: 這裡的垂直距離很小。

cues.en: So definitely it is shorter than the previous vertical distance we made just before.
cues.zh: 顯然比上一步的垂直距離短。

cues.en: And therefore, the optimal number of clusters is definitely not one, two, three and four.
cues.zh: 因此最佳群組數量肯定不是一、二、三、四。

cues.en: It's definitely not four.
cues.zh: 肯定不是四群。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Okay, but let's continue.
cues.zh: 好，繼續。

cues.en: Maybe there is a higher vertical move we can make in the next step.
cues.zh: 下一步也許能移動更大的垂直距離。

cues.en: And you know exactly that this is gonna be the case because we already did k-means.
cues.zh: 因為已經做過 K-means，你知道這確實會發生。

cues.en: But there we go.
cues.zh: 來吧。

cues.en: That's next move, we start from here.
cues.zh: 下一次移動從這裡開始。

cues.en: That last horizontal bar we met, and I'm gonna expand this in order to not miss any horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 從最後碰到的水平線開始，把範圍展開，避免漏掉任何水平線。

cues.en: And actually, I should even take the whole width.
cues.zh: 其實應該取整張圖的寬度。

cues.en: I should take exactly this.
cues.zh: 應該剛好取這樣。

cues.en: All right, so that we can make sure we don't miss any horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 這樣才能確定不會漏掉任何水平線。

cues.en: So we start from here, and here we go.
cues.zh: 從這裡開始，來吧。

cues.en: Let's move down, let's move down, move down, move down, move down until we meet the next horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 往下移、往下、往下、往下，直到碰到下一條水平線。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 到了。

cues.en: Right, you see?
cues.zh: 你看到了嗎？

cues.en: That's the next horizontal bar we met.
cues.zh: 這是碰到的下一條水平線。

cues.en: The one from that last cluster here.
cues.zh: 也就是這裡最後這個群組的線。

cues.en: And well, now the question is, is that vertical move, vertical distance we just made here, bigger than the one we made in the second step,
cues.zh: 現在問題是，剛才移動的垂直距離，有沒有比第二步的距離大，

cues.en: meaning this one?
cues.zh: 也就是這一段？

cues.en: Well, it seems to be the case, right?
cues.zh: 看起來是這樣，對吧？

cues.en: It seems to be that this vertical distance is actually larger than this vertical distance.
cues.zh: 看來這個垂直距離確實比這個大。

cues.en: How could we actually measure this to be exactly sure.
cues.zh: 要怎麼實際量測，才能完全確定？

cues.en: Well, have a look at the pixel here, 264 times 66.
cues.zh: 看看這裡的像素數，264 乘以 66。

cues.en: I don't know if you can see it well.
cues.zh: 不知道你看不看得清楚。

cues.en: But if I move up, remember there was 66, well actually zero.
cues.zh: 如果我往上移，記得剛才是 66，現在其實是 0。

cues.en: Okay, so that's very easy.
cues.zh: 好，這很簡單。

cues.en: So there are actually 66 pixels here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡實際是 66 個像素。

cues.en: All right, cool.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: And now let's do this again here from that horizontal bar and up to here.
cues.zh: 現在從那條水平線到這裡，再做一次。

cues.en: And wow, okay, so that was very short actually because here the vertical distance is actually 67 pixel.
cues.zh: 哇，好，其實差距很小，因為這裡的垂直距離是 67 個像素。

cues.en: You see it?
cues.zh: 看到了嗎？

cues.en: 272 times 67.
272 is actually the width of that rectangle I just made with my mouse.
cues.zh: 272 其實是剛才用滑鼠畫出的矩形寬度。

cues.en: And 67 is the height, and that's the height we're interested in because that corresponds to the distance of the vertical move.
cues.zh: 67 是高度，我們關心的是高度，因為它對應垂直移動的距離。

cues.en: So actually 67 versus 66.
cues.zh: 所以其實是 67 對 66。

cues.en: So, well, you know, three clusters is actually a good number of clusters.
cues.zh: 這樣看來，三群其實也是很好的群組數量。

cues.en: But since we already did it with k-means and on the elbow method, we clearly identified that the optimal number of was five.
cues.zh: 不過已經用 K-means 和手肘法，明確辨識出最佳數量是五群。

cues.en: Well, we're gonna take that one pixel difference here in order to still keep, well, five as the optimal number of clusters.
cues.zh: 所以就採用這裡一個像素的差距，繼續把五群作為最佳群組數量。

cues.en: But it's really interesting that we did this dendrogram.
cues.zh: 不過做這張樹狀圖真的很有意思。

cues.en: I actually didn't notice before that we were so close from my vision, I had the impression that this distance was larger, but there you go.
cues.zh: 我之前其實沒注意到兩者這麼接近，肉眼看時感覺這段更大，但你看。

cues.en: This one was also very good.
cues.zh: 這個也很好。

cues.en: Let's check it again, because I just wanna make sure.
cues.zh: 再檢查一次，想確認一下。

cues.en: Yes, 66.
But even 67 depends down to where you go exactly in that horizontal bar.
cues.zh: 甚至也可能是 67，要看你在線上具體量到哪裡。

cues.en: Actually, to make it super thorough, we would need to start from here, at the bottom of the horizontal bar up to the top of the next vertical bar.
cues.zh: 其實要非常嚴謹，應該從這裡水平線的底部，量到下一條線的頂部。

cues.en: So here we have 65.
cues.zh: 這裡是 65。

cues.en: And for that next distance, well, I'm starting from the bottom of the horizontal bar and going here, 65, the same, it's the same.
cues.zh: 下一段也從水平線底部開始，量到這裡，65，一樣，完全一樣。

cues.en: So actually three clusters or five clusters is very good.
cues.zh: 所以其實三群或五群都很好。

cues.en: And so feel free to continue this implementation with either three or five.
cues.zh: 你可以自由選三群或五群，繼續這個實作。

cues.en: But since with k-means we identified five clusters as the optimal number of clusters, well, we're still gonna go with five here, but there you go.
cues.zh: 但既然用 K-means 辨識出的最佳群組數量是五群，這裡仍然選五群，就是這樣。

cues.en: That's a very good example because indeed in some situations we can have two optimal number of clusters.
cues.zh: 這是個很好的例子，因為某些情況確實可能有兩個最佳群組數量。

cues.en: All right, so I'm really glad I showed you this.
cues.zh: 所以很高興能示範給你看。

cues.en: And mostly this shows you the importance of trying several models because indeed having another model can give you extra insight when doing your machinery task.
cues.zh: 這也特別顯示，嘗試多種模型很重要，因為另一個模型可以為機器學習任務提供額外洞見。

cues.en: And with hierarchical clustering, that extra insight is that three clusters actually makes a lot of sense as well.
cues.zh: 在階層式分群中，這個額外洞見就是三群其實也很合理。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Make sure to keep hierarchical clustering your toolkit in order to catch these extra insights in your future data sets for your future clustering problems.
cues.zh: 務必把階層式分群留在工具箱裡，未來面對資料集與分群問題時，才能掌握這些額外洞見。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: So let's close this and let's go back to our implementation.
cues.zh: 關掉這裡，回到實作。

cues.en: And now for the next step we're gonna train that hierarchical clustering model as we set five clusters in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一步會在下一堂訓練階層式分群模型，按剛才說的選五群。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy clustering and machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受分群與機器學習的樂趣。
